scientific.integrity: The primary full text was inspected at the model, derivative and integral definitions, existence equations, numerical equations, stated initial data, parameter table, and simulation figures. The proof uses the displayed equations directly. The bundled checker replays exact arithmetic and a constant-input history identity. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The general Caputo–Fabrizio initial-compatibility restriction is prior literature; the source-specific contribution is the exact published-data incompatibility and the independent history-identity failure in the numerical derivation. The result does not exclude oscillation or chaos in a separately defined compatible fractional model, and it does not apply to the ordinary differential-equation case of order one.

title: The fractional HIV simulations violate the model’s initial compatibility and history identity
